1. A Democratic president was elected to a first term, served two full terms, and was succeeded by a Republican

- "Two full terms" = served 8 years (not partial terms from succession)
- "Succeeded by Republican" = next president was Republican

### Query 2 (High depth): Female American Olympic All-Around gymnastics champions
- Search for: All women's Olympic All-Around gold medalists, identify American winners and their Olympic years
- Event started: 1952 Helsinki
- Known American winners: Mary Lou Retton (1984), Carly Patterson (2004), Nastia Liukin (2008), Gabby Douglas (2012), Simone Biles (2016), Sunisa Lee (2020/2021)

### Query 3 (Medium depth): Cross-reference election years with Olympic years
- Olympic years are even years (Summer Olympics), same as presidential election years
- Check intersection of qualifying presidential election years with American women's All-Around gold years

- 2016: Trump elected (Republican) - Olympics in Rio, Simone Biles (American) won AA gold

- "Served two full terms" - exclude FDR (4 terms but died), JFK (assassinated), LBJ (partial + one full), Carter (one term)
- Confirm women's AA event didn't exist before 1952
